# T7-OPERATIONS

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_system_docs.py; edit source manifests, schemas or detailed docs -->

Detailed sources: `docs/architecture/storage.md`,
`docs/operations/t7-physical-profile.md`, and
`docs/target-binding/t7-readonly-preflight.json`.

- T7 is append-only cold recovery storage.
- Active databases and WAL files must never be placed there.
- Format, erase, restore, sync and destructive storage operations require
  explicit native target authority.
- Current SRF state records `WAIT_T7_BINDING`; software validation continues
  independently while protected binding remains parked.
